summary: Frontend verification of the promoted /inventory standalone module. All 8 test areas passed on desktop and mobile — new route, redirect from /service-desk/inventory, area switcher round-trip (main/service-desk/inventory listed with inventory active), Service Desk sidebar link, Master Admin quick-launch button, mobile off-canvas drawer, and data flow (all 6 inventory API endpoints returned 200 including POST /api/inventory/intel/scan).
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryDistribution.js is ~525 lines — still within limits but growing; if more sections are added, consider extracting Dashboard/Warehouses/StockAvailability/SageConnection/FieldOwnership/SettingsView into their own files (they are already colocated modules, so this is only a maintainability nudge).

AreaSwitcher.accessibleAreas: Inventory area is gated identically to Service Desk (canServiceDesk). This is intentional per the spec but note that any user without is_service_desk still can't reach /inventory even if they had a legitimate inventory-only capability in future — worth revisiting if inventory becomes a standalone permission.
AppRoutes.js line 517 wraps <InventoryDistribution/> in a `display: contents` div only for the pulse-font class — small; acceptable but slightly inconsistent with sibling routes.
seed_data_creation: None — DB was empty as expected; empty states rendered cleanly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 scenarios verified end-to-end via Playwright on the live preview URL. Owner (owner@isodemo.com) can reach /inventory, sees the Service-Desk-style shell (data-testid inventory-distribution-page), heading 'Inventory & Distribution', all NAV groups present with inv-nav-* testids, clicking inv-nav-orders updates URL to ?s=orders without leaving /inventory. /service-desk/inventory correctly redirects to /inventory. AreaSwitcher on /inventory exposes area-switcher-{main,service-desk,inventory}; clicking service-desk navigates to /service-desk; reverse works via area-switcher-inventory. desk-tab-inventory-distribution on /service-desk navigates to /inventory. On mobile (420px), inv-sidebar-open opens drawer with inv-sidebar-backdrop and inv-sidebar-close; selecting a nav item closes the drawer. Master Admin sees portal-switch-inventory (Boxes icon) in AdminSidebar right after portal-switch-service-desk; clicking loads /inventory with the shell rendered. All 6 inventory API endpoints returned 200: /api/inventory/dashboard, /orders, /dist/shipments, /alloc/allocations, /svc/desks, /intel/overview and POST /intel/scan. No CSP-blocked scripts affected app functionality (only 3rd-party posthog/emergent/cloudflare beacons blocked, which is expected).
